description: On a computer the Penna library lives in the home or Documents folder, or in any folder picked in the dialog; its automatic copies in backups/ in Penna's own folder; persisted-scope keeps picked folders across restarts. Updates come from GitHub Releases. The text's own menu reads the clipboard for Klistra in. The window has no frame, so Penna's top bar moves, minimises, maximises and closes it.
